description: What a FOP ledger does with every column of cost_basis_events. tests/cost_basis_fop_contract_test.py fails when the table has a column this file does not decide, or this file names a column the table lacks.

rules.kind_whitelist: Only the kinds allowed in event_kinds.json.
rules.economic: The only copy of quantity, price, cash and fees; validated per kind (event_kinds.json).
rules.server_projection: Generated by the server from cost_basis_fop_event_details; a client value is not used. FOP ordering, dedupe, cycles and as-of views never read it.
rules.fixed_empty_string: Always ''. Open/close, fee, baseline and refund meaning live in cost_basis_fop_event_details.
rules.include_in_cost_rule: May be false only on an event without quantity (plan §1.3).
rules.server_computed: Computed by the server from the cash rules; a client value is not used.
rules.common_source: Shared meaning; external_ref is the account-scoped key derived from the primary source record. The source table keeps each source once and is what de-duplicates it: a source allocated to several events (plan §8.1) gives each of those events the source key followed by # and its own event id, so the key stays unique per event.
rules.free_text: Free text with no economic meaning.
rules.null_identity: Stored NULL; a read-only display projection is generated from the contract reference. Writing a value is refused.
rules.null_not_writable: Stored NULL and never written: months live in the contract table and ROLL is not persisted.
rules.rejected_equity: Stock-only field: a non-null (or non-default) value is refused.
